title: DIF Nuevo Laredo to Hold Free Children's Rights Fair Friday, November 27
excerpt: DIF Nuevo Laredo will hold a free Children's Rights Fair on Friday, November 27, from 9 a.m. to 2 p.m. at DIF Central, offering free medical, dental, psychological, and legal services for children.
content:
DIF Nuevo Laredo will hold a free Children's Rights Fair this Friday, November 27, offering specialized medical care, psychological support, and family legal guidance to children and their parents, according to CML Noticias.

The fair runs from 9:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m. at DIF Central, located at Héroe de Nacataz #2244 in the Ojo Caliente neighborhood.

Families will be able to access free neurology, traumatology, general medicine, pediatrics, and pediatric dentistry consultations, along with psychological care, family legal advice, vaccinations, weight and height checks, and children's haircuts, CML Noticias reported.

The event is organized by the DIF Nuevo Laredo board, led by president Claudette Canturosas Villarreal. DIF director general Roberto Viviano Vázquez Macías invited families to take part, saying the fair was prepared to bring specialized services closer to children and support their well-being.

The fair is held in observance of World Children's Day, marked each November 20, which highlights the rights of children and adolescents to health, education, protection, and a life free of violence, according to the report.

Source: CML Noticias, November 24, 2026.
